comment: The least-privilege policy of MiniDAQ's agent files (roadmap 2.2.0, Theme P2; CR-0036), read by tools/check_agent_files.py. 'required' lists the frontmatter fields a file of the kind must have; 'tools' the only tools it may allow (a Bash rule names its command); 'forbidden' the permission rules that settings may not allow (regular expressions on the whole rule); 'deny' the rules that settings must deny; 'modes' the default modes settings may set. A change to this file is a change to a check the agent gate runs, so a person reviews it.
